# BTHWANI Design Sovereignty

## When to Use

- Designing or reviewing any serious shell, screen, flow slice, or reusable pattern
- Judging premium quality, hierarchy, modernity, density, clarity, or attractiveness
- Deciding whether a screen is strong enough to become a reusable visual standard
- Auditing Arabic and RTL polish

## Premium Design Mission

You are not allowed to produce merely clean screens.
You must produce premium, modern, elegant, high-attraction, low-noise, high-clarity screens.

Cleanliness alone is insufficient.
Structural correctness alone is insufficient.
Legacy-safety alone is insufficient.

Every accepted screen or shell must also satisfy elite design quality.

For every screen, shell, flow, or reusable pattern, optimize for:

- premium visual hierarchy
- modern luxury feel
- high attractiveness
- strong clarity
- elegant density
- low cognitive load
- intelligent CTA prominence
- smooth state transitions
- zero clutter
- zero accidental ugliness
- zero generic enterprise noise
- modern and future-safe UI quality
- highly legible RTL-first polish
- reusable beauty, not one-off beauty

## No Generic Screen Law

Reject any screen that is merely:

- acceptable
- ordinary
- standard
- safe but bland
- clean but visually weak
- modern-looking but shallow
- functional yet emotionally flat

The target is not "works".
The target is "exceptional".

## Premium UX Within Design

Every accepted screen must prove:

- one dominant primary CTA
- obvious reading hierarchy
- minimal decision friction
- strong first-glance comprehension
- progressive disclosure where complexity exists
- smart defaults where choice burden can be reduced
- compactness without crowding
- elegance without ornamental noise
- premium rhythm in spacing, grouping, and hierarchy
- visible user confidence in the next action

## Calm Premium Comfort Law

Every accepted visual direction must also prove:

- modern, calm, elegant presentation rather than loud complexity
- immediate comfort for a first-time user
- visual quietness around the main action
- high attractiveness without decorative excess
- consistency across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints
- reusable visual decisions that can scale without drift or duplication

## Luxury Visual Law

Every accepted screen must prove:

- beautiful spacing rhythm
- premium card anatomy
- refined contrast hierarchy
- elegant emphasis placement
- modern section composition
- polished icon/text balance
- premium empty states
- premium loading states
- premium action rows
- premium surface composition

## RTL Excellence Law

RTL correctness is not enough.

Every RTL screen must also prove:

- natural visual balance
- natural action placement
- proper mirrored hierarchy when needed
- elegant Arabic reading rhythm
- zero awkward alignment hacks
- zero mixed-direction ugliness
- premium Arabic-first visual confidence

## Design Extraction Law

When donor screens contain strong beauty or strong visual intelligence:

- do not copy them blindly
- extract their visual law
- extract their hierarchy law
- extract their card/shell law
- extract their CTA law
- extract their density law
- extract their grouping law
- extract their premium feel drivers

Then rebuild them cleanly and better.

## Comparative Quality Check

Before accepting a slice, compare it against top-tier modern product quality expectations.

Do not ask:

- is this usable?

Ask:

- is this elite?
- is this premium?
- is this visually memorable?
- is this emotionally convincing?
- is this more elegant than the average market product?
- is this worthy of becoming a reusable standard?

## Required Review Output

For every serious implementation slice, include:

- Design strengths
- Design weaknesses
- Luxury score
- Modernity score
- Clarity score
- CTA quality score
- RTL polish score
- Reusability pressure score
- Accept / Revise verdict

## Design Score Gate

No screen may be accepted without evaluating these dimensions:

- hierarchy
- clarity
- luxury feel
- modernity
- attractiveness
- density quality
- CTA discipline
- state quality
- RTL polish
- reusability pressure
- shell consistency
- visual memorability

Use this verdict scale:

- FAIL
- WEAK
- PASS
- STRONG
- ELITE

Only PASS and above may proceed.
Only STRONG and ELITE are desirable.
Repeated WEAK results must trigger redesign.
